Server settings

Customize your community and manage access.

Customize the server's identity and community information. Use the server menu's “Change server icon” for image/GIF uploads.

Create roles and select what each role can do. The server owner and Prism platform admins keep full access. New members receive the default Member permissions unless you assign another role.

Built-in commands

Boost this server with Prism Coins. Each boost is permanent while you're a member, and every boost unlocks 5 custom emoji slots for the server. 10 boosts unlocks a custom server tag, Level 2 unlocks a banner, and 20 boosts unlocks an animated icon and banner.

Webhooks forward this server's chat messages to an outside service (for example a Discord channel). They fire when someone posts in a chat channel — forum replies don't trigger them. The URL is only shown to managers, and only its domain is displayed here.

New webhook (managers only)

Posts go out as JSON with the author, channel, server and message text. If the service blocks browser posts, Prism retries once without CORS headers.
